explanation: One of Job's three friends who came to comfort and speak with Job during his trials.
The main character in the book, a righteous man who experiences great suffering and seeks to understand God's will.
A moral quality that involves acting in accordance with divine or moral laws and principles.
Physical or emotional pain, distress, or discomfort that Job endures throughout the book.
The ability to use knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judge rightly.
Respect and reverence for God, recognized as an important part of living a righteous life.
Support and care that Eliphaz and the other friends try to give Job during his trials.
The difficult situations and challenges Job must face as a result of his suffering.
